svg.title: Results: valve and fouling
svg.text: Result 2 · The air valve is essential, and the disc fouls fast

text.tspan: Without a way for air to return, a bottle stalls after one squeeze. With it, the limit becomes how quickly fine solids clog the 1 µm disc.

svg.text: Water delivered vs time, 60 N squeezes, 500 mL bottle

text.tspan: Without a valve, a dented bottle pulls
of vacuum, as much as the squeeze. Flow stops
Air can't come back through the wet 1 µm disc: that needs

svg.text: Flow at 60 N vs litres filtered, tap water (0.5 mg/L)

text.tspan: our 20 L target and the team's 100 L filter rating (9.1).
after 9 flushes (3 % stays each time). The disc is spent
